code-runner.executorMap.java: cls; [Console]::OutputEncoding = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8; javac -encoding UTF-8 -d "$workspaceRoot/out/production/TheDSAJournal" -cp "$workspaceRoot/src" $fullFileName; if ($?) { $p = (Get-Content $fullFileName -TotalCount 10 | Select-String 'package\s+([\w\.]+);').Matches.Groups[1].Value; $c = if ($p) { "$p.$fileNameWithoutExt" } else { "$fileNameWithoutExt" }; java "-Dfile.encoding=UTF-8" -cp "$workspaceRoot/out/production/TheDSAJournal" $c }
